title: I know its not great (yet) but please help me ideate
author: unlikely-ape
selftext: Im working on this dumb game for months now and Opus 5 is just slowed me down a lot and now im second guessing myself.... Ideas how i could make this game better? I have hundreds of hours in Oxygen not Included, Ale Abbey, and other similar games and wanted to give it a try myself. My idea is to build a story around this all the way from the 1970s starting from a garage and then ending in the AI era with massive DCs. So far some functions work better than others as you can see from the jank... Ohh and dont hate my chrome tabs pls, i have 96gigs of RAM lol

comments.author: Old_Swan8945
comments.body: Looks interesting although I'm not sure I understand the concept yet. Are you trying to build a story? Is this something about industrial facilities? It looks like there's a lot in here but I'm not sure how the gameplay would actually work.

replies.author: unlikely-ape
replies.body: It's data centers haha. So what you see is basically a complete power delivery, cooling, networking system supporting servers, GPUs, CPUs eetc.The main goal is to fulfill contracts from other hyperscalers like yourself and make money in the process. You also need to manage the local community so they don't get their pitchforks. The main gameplay loop is managing your inventory, expanding your data centers and managing the political situation around the DCs. There are random events ( the popup in the video) as well so far.

replies.author: Old_Swan8945
replies.body: Have you engaged with any people to try playing it? I think there are people that might be interested in playing it here although they might need something simpler to start off with.

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: While this wouldn't be a game for me, it definitely looks like a game for *someone*

replies.author: unlikely-ape
replies.body: This is how I read your message 😂

comments.author: unlikely-ape
comments.body: Realized my 2AM rambling was a bit meh. Will come back when I'm closer to something that I'm proud of.
